cases.requirement: Prompt includes the frozen selected approach and forbids changing it.
Both tiers share task ID, version, source commit, goal, scope, acceptance, and stop conditions.
Failure report requires last successful gate, failed step, raw error, side effects, safe resume point, and required decision.
Execution result requires changed files, tests, diff, commit, remote SHA, artifacts, limitations, unfinished items, and workspace state.
Canonical Contract freezes current/target branch, push target, PR/merge policy, and exact deletion authorization.
Chat Review alone must not create or push a remote feature branch.
